body: For you, 7 Nov 2026 night (information, nothing to do now): every build so far, including build 144 that is on your phone, is signed with this PC's Android debug key (same certificate on builds 138 and 144, checked with apksigner). Two consequences. (1) Updating your phone over build 144 works as long as I keep using this PC's key; if this PC is reinstalled or that key file is lost, the next build cannot be installed over it and you would have to uninstall first. (2) When your release key is made (this item), your phone needs ONE uninstall and reinstall, because Android refuses to update an app with a different key; your account and library are on the server, downloaded songs download again. The cheapest moment for that single reinstall is soon, before your phone holds many downloads. My suggestion: do this item right after you report back on your week, not in the middle of it, and keep using build 144 until then. The steps will be given to you one at a time when you say go.
